title: Design: Long Bill To name is cut at the card edge with no ellipsis
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Give customer A a name longer than 25 characters (for example "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair").
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-06-after-picked.png, bt-p2-08-after-s2-17579.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bill To shows the start of customer A's name cut at the card's right edge (for example "Valders Diesel & Fleet Re"), with no "..." and no tooltip.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R2: “The field reads "This customer" when the customer pays for itself, otherwise the Bill To's name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
